content: Closest to our work are two-pass models for document-level NMT BIBREF24, BIBREF11, where a second, context-aware model takes the translation and hidden representations of the sentence-level first-pass model as its input. The second-pass model can in principle be trained on a subset of the parallel training data BIBREF11, somewhat relaxing the assumption that all training data is at the document level.
